title: Write Scope Revocation
description: First-class operator kill switch for a WriteScopeApproval. Revocation is idempotent but auditable: repeating revoke for an already-revoked approval returns the existing record and emits an audit event. reason is human rationale and non-authoritative for identity.

revocation_id.description: Deterministic id: wsr- + sha256(approval_id)[:24]. One durable revocation identity per approval.

revoked_by.description: Operator identity asserted at revoke time.

revoked_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the first successful revocation. Idempotent re-revoke preserves the original revoked_at.

reason.description: Human rationale. Non-authoritative; does not alter approval identity or path grants.
